mapper.sql: WITH activities AS ( SELECT ('활동 예시 ' || LPAD(n::text, 2, '0'))::text AS title, CASE WHEN n % 4 = 0 THEN 'QNA'::text ELSE 'OTHER'::text END AS board_type, (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp - ((n - 1) / 4) * INTERVAL '1 month' + LEAST((n - 1) % 4, EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE)::integer - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamp AS ins_dt FROM generate_series(1, 24) AS n )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalActivities", COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE ins_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND ins_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS "periodActivities", COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE ins_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ins_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS "currentMonthActivities", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE board_type = 'QNA') AS "inquiryCount" FROM activities

, months AS ( SELECT generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS month_start ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(a.ins_dt) AS count FROM months m LEFT JOIN activities a ON a.ins_dt >= m.month_start AND a.ins_dt < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start

SELECT CASE WHEN board_type = 'QNA' THEN '문의'::text ELSE '게시글'::text END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM activities GROUP BY CASE WHEN board_type = 'QNA' THEN '문의'::text ELSE '게시글'::text END ORDER BY label
SELECT title, CASE WHEN board_type = 'QNA' THEN '문의'::text ELSE '게시글'::text END AS type, TO_CHAR(ins_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date FROM activities ORDER BY ins_dt DESC, title LIMIT 5
mapper.select: SELECT #{source}::text AS source, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "asOf", TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "periodStart", TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "periodEnd"
